observations: Photo shows multiple used engine mounts/insulators and rubber bushings (metal brackets with circular rubber centers).
Several parts are rusty and dusty; rubber appears aged (no clear fresh condition).
No clear engine model/brand markings are readable on the parts shown.
Seller text is unclear/grammatically broken and does not match a specific item clearly.

claims.claim: For engine seatng and engines mouthing
claims.evidence: Seller words are unclear; photo shows engine-mount related parts but does not confirm what exact set/quantity is being sold.

risks.risk: Wrong fitment (engine mount positions differ by engine model/year/chassis). Photos don’t show any part numbers or the engine it came from.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of any part numbers/labels on each mount and a photo showing the mounts installed on the engine (or the engine model/vehicle VIN/engine code).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as generic/possibly non-fitting used engine mounts (worst case: buyer may need to replace or return), so value should be low.

risks.risk: Rubber deterioration (mounts may be cracked/soft, causing vibration even if metal brackets look intact).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the rubber centers (front + side) showing cracks, separation, and any missing chunks.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worn/possibly failing mounts (worst case: not good for smooth mounting).

risks.risk: Incomplete set / unknown quantity (photo shows multiple pieces but not a confirmed full set for one engine).
risks.proof: Ask seller to list exact quantity and which positions (e.g., left/right/front/rear) and provide a laid-out photo with count.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as partial/uncertain set (worst case: not complete).

risks.risk: Condition issues from corrosion (rusted metal brackets may be weakened or have seized hardware).
risks.proof: Photos of mounting holes/threads and any bolts/nuts included; show close-ups of rust severity at stress points.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as heavily used with possible hardware issues.

proof_requests: Confirm exactly what is being sold: engine mount set for which engine/vehicle (engine code or vehicle model/year).
Provide close-up photos of each mount’s rubber condition (cracks, separation) and any part numbers/markings.
Provide a laid-out photo showing the full quantity and which mount goes where (front/rear/left/right).
If any bolts/hardware are included, show them clearly (threads condition).
response.reason: The photo shows used engine-mount related parts, but the exact item set, fitment, and rubber condition cannot be confirmed from the single image and unclear seller text. Without fitment/quantity proof, pricing would be too speculative.
